title: Too much play time without meaningful progress
evidence: 77% of all play time of `best_roi` is spent in stretches longer than 5 min before purchases add up to +5% income (47 dead zones, 487 min in total). 42 of them fit inside a single session (*idle sessions*): the offline earnings are spent in the first seconds of a 10-minute session and the rest of the session adds almost nothing.
action: Give the session itself something to do: raise active income relative to offline (lower `offline.efficiency` 0.5 → 0.35, or raise `tap.upgrades.showman.value` (0.01 → 0.02)), and/or add short in-session goals in the game design (NPC events while playing, timed boosts). In the economy, more mid-sized purchases per tier (a 4th staff type, more equipment levels) also break up the waits.

title: Long wait for `franchise`
evidence: On day 5.0 (stage: restaurant (run 1)) the player waits **40 min of play** (≈ 4 sessions, 29.0 h calendar) until `franchise`; meanwhile only 1 small purchase (mostly `night_shift`).
action: Wall before **franchise**. Keep the pacing target and fill the gap with content in the `restaurant` tier: e.g. a 4th staff item with `base_cost` ≈ 12T and `income` ≈ 380M (base payback ~1.6x the last staff), or more levels on `interior` (`max_level` +5). Lowering `tiers.franchise.unlock_cost` also helps but moves the franchise milestone earlier.

evidence: On day 9.0 (stage: franchise (run 1)) the player waits **30 min of play** (≈ 3 sessions, 24.0 h calendar) until `marketing_dept`; meanwhile only 0 small purchases.

title: Offline earnings dominate
evidence: From day 2 on, 89% of `best_roi`'s coins come from offline earnings; the 10-minute sessions add little beyond spending.
action: Fine for a relaxed idle game. If sessions should matter more, lower `offline.efficiency` (0.5 → 0.35) or reduce manager `offline_cap_hours_add`, and re-run `tune` (pacing will slow down).

title: `cheapest` stalls before cafe
evidence: `cheapest` reaches `cafe` after 5.0 h vs 8.5 min for `best_roi` (same sessions, different buying).
action: Players who buy naively get stuck: show a 'best buy' hint in the UI, and/or steepen `cost_growth` of the cheapest generators (e.g. `nephew` 1.12 → 1.14) so cheap items stop soaking up cash.

title: Saving for cafe beats greedy ROI
evidence: `saver` reaches `cafe` after 5.8 min vs 8.5 min for `best_roi`.
action: The cafe unlock is worth more than its immediate income gain suggests (its global multiplier and new items). Fine as a skill expression; if unwanted, lower `tiers.cafe.global_income_mult`.
